NewsArticle.Title: Public Politics
NewsArticle.Content:
Politics become more public at Aisling and mundane request.
Public Political actions require an assistant who has 1 Clout or more. The public political actions are spoken, so that others nearby can hear. Widdle is still anonymous but deducts 2 clout from the widdler instead of 1.
Public Actions
- Attack
- Endow
- Exile
- Forgive Exile
- Remove
- Widdle
Mundanes: Cedric at Mileth Hall; Eduardo at Rucesion Hall.
Citizen actions are under a new menu button.
Civic Actions
- Admit Citizen
- Leave
- Support
Mundanes: Aingeal at Mileth Tavern; Angelo at Rucesion Storage
